maddeler.e:
نستهبل (form X)
# نَسْتَهْبِلُ (nastahbilu) /nas.tah.bi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْبَلَ (istahbala)
# نَسْتَهْبِلَ (nastahbila) /nas.tah.bi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَهْبَلَ (istahbala)
# نَسْتَهْبِلْ (nastahbil) /nas.tah.bil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَهْبَلَ (istahbala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
